modern: Within ten days you will seem a god to those to whom you are now a beast and an ape, if you return to your principles and the worship of reason.

explained.summary: People who now think of you as an animal could see you as almost godlike within ten days, if you go back to your principles and to living by reason. Marcus means that respect isn’t won by status or cleverness but by how you live, and it can come back fast once you return to what matters.
